sql:
SELECT COALESCE((
      SELECT json_agg((to_jsonb(s) - 'ord') ORDER BY s.ord)
        FROM (
          SELECT q.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY q.occurred_at DESC, q.id::bigint DESC) AS ord
            FROM (SELECT a.id::text AS id,
       to_char(a.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS occurred_key,
       a.occurred_at,
       coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.display_name), ''), '') AS actor_name,
       (a.actor_user_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_actor,
       a.table_name,
       a.row_id,
       a.action::text AS action,
       a.event_type,
       a.changed_cols,
       a.reason
  FROM audit_log a
  LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id = a.actor_user_id
 WHERE a.org_id = $1
   AND a.occurred_at >= $2::timestamptz
   AND a.occurred_at < $3::timestamptz
 ORDER BY a.occurred_at DESC, a.id DESC
 LIMIT $4) q
        ) s
    ), '[]'::json) AS page,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
               'id', m.user_id::text,
               'name', coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.display_name), ''), '')
             ) ORDER BY coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.display_name), ''), ''), m.user_id)
        FROM org_members m
        LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id = m.user_id
       WHERE m.org_id = $1 AND m.status = 'active'
    ), '[]'::json) AS actors

SELECT 'contacts' AS src, id::text AS id, display_name AS text, NULL::text AS parent, is_tenant, is_owner, NULL::text AS mode
    FROM contacts
   WHERE org_id = $1 AND id = ANY($2::uuid[])
UNION ALL
SELECT 'leases' AS src, l.id::text AS id, btrim(c.display_name || ' ' || p.name || ' ' || u.label || coalesce(' ' || r.label, '')) AS text, NULL::text AS parent, NULL::boolean AS is_tenant, NULL::boolean AS is_owner, NULL::text AS mode
    FROM leases l
    
  JOIN properties p ON p.id = l.property_id
  JOIN units u ON u.id = l.unit_id
  LEFT JOIN rooms r ON r.id = l.target_room_id
  JOIN lease_parties lp ON lp.lease_id = l.id AND lp.role = 'primary'
  JOIN contacts c ON c.id = lp.contact_id
   WHERE l.org_id = $1 AND l.id = ANY($3::uuid[])
